lines.speaker: Sasuke
lines.text: Hmph. So you're the nuisance wandering through these woods.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Sasuke! Sheathe your sword and let me pass.

lines.speaker: Sasuke
lines.text: You don't command me. You lack the resolve to walk the path ahead.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: I'll make you step aside by force if I have to!

lines.speaker: Sasuke
lines.text: Show me your strength, then... or perish in the dark!
